after.title: Overview of AI security risks
after.description: Recognise the main categories of security risk affecting AI systems and agents, informed by OWASP's LLM and agentic risk frameworks: instruction manipulation, sensitive-information disclosure, unsafe output handling, excessive permissions or actions, compromised components or information sources, and service disruption or uncontrolled resource consumption. Explain a simple example of each and identify an appropriate precaution or escalation route. Foundation awareness does not require threat modelling or memorising framework identifiers.
